s: Dine shette gezuzetraot bishte aliyyot ubo seip echad: shette gezuzetraot habboletot mib' aliyyot zo keneged zo, venatan benehen neser kemin gesher mizzo lezo uqebao sham bemasmer shello yukal lehinnatel beshabbat (o shebbittelo beperush lekol hashshabbat), im hu rachab d' — hare hu kepetach umeorbin yachad, veim ratzu, kol achat mearebet leatzmah. Abal im hayu zo shello keneged zo, apillu im zo beruach zo vezo beruach shekkenegdo, kegon shezzo batztzapon vezo baddarom ella sheachat meshuka lammizrach veachat lammaarab veenan mekuvvanot zo keneged zo — enan yekolim leareb yachad, mippene shehanneser sheyyittenu mizzo lezo yabo miqqeren zavit shel zo leshel zo veeno chashub kepetach, sheen derek laasot petach beqeren zavit. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehen meshukot zo mikkeneged zo g' tepachim, abal pachot mig' tepachim eno kelum, vekimkuvvanot hen. Vaapillu im hen mekuvvanot mammash, im haachat gaboah mechabertah g' tepachim — eno chashub petach. Vekol zeh keshehen rechoqot zo mizzo. Abal im en hammerchaq shebbenehen d', ap sheen sham neser kelal — meorbin yachad, mippene shennoach lipsoa missepat zo lispat zo ukeillu hen semukot zo lezo mammash. Velaken enan yekolim leareb kol achat leatzmah uletaltel zo beshellah vezo beshellah, mippene shehen oserot zo al zo, kevan shehen qerobot zo lezo betok d', ella im ken qerub zeh shebbenehen eno bemilluo ella beemtza rochban bilbad, sheyyesh sham belita, abal biqtzotehen hen rechoqot zo mizzo d', vegam en beqerub zeh yoter measara ammot. Bammeh debarim amurim? Letaltel bigzuzetraot atzman. Abal haaliyyot sheetzlan yekola kol achat leareb leatzmah im habbattim shebbachatzerah, ap al pi sheggezuzetraotehem semukot zo lezo, raq shello yetaltelu bigzuzetraot. Veim yirtzu yekolim apillu kol habbattim shebbachatzar aliyya zo leareb im kol habbattim shebbachatzar aliyya zo, lepi shehaggezuzetraot hen petach benehen, raq sheyyihyu sullamot kedinam mehabbattim laaliyyot. Vehu haddin im haggezuzetraot rechoqot ella shennatan neser mizzo lezo:
